thread:
ashwin: Heads up 1: our allocator just flagged a mismatch for inbound rack shipment (batch-4). Manifest arrived via SFTP but EDI ACK missing allocation details so reservations didn't reconcile.

maria: Which partner is this? same as last-month header change?

ashwin: supply-partner again. We have manifest file SP-20241218-B4 in SFTP, but EDI x12 ACK not in the queue at 02:00 UTC. ops-bot kicked an alert.

ops-bot: auto-alert: ingest.fail EDI pipeline: missing_allocation_segment::supply-partner::batch4 at 2024-12-18T02:05Z

jordan: Can you paste sanitized manifest snippet + what our allocator expected? need rack counts.

ashwin: Manifest: 12 racks. Allocator expected 16 (we reserved 4 for a Dedicated customer ramp).

ashwin: ```
MANIFEST_ID: SP-20241218-B4
ITEM: rack-unit-42 qty: 12
ETA: 2024-12-20T06:00Z
```

sam: Without allocation segment we treat this as partial fulfillment and keep reserved units locked. That can reduce customer-ready capacity.

karen: If customer-facing capacity drops that's a launch risk. We need options before 11:00 PM sync.

maria: Action plan now: 1) ask supply-partner to re-transmit EDI ACK with shipment_allocation segment + reservation IDs; 2) check dedicated-spare-commit pool; 3) pause any joint announcement referencing guaranteed racks.

ashwin: Pinged supply-partner (cc @supply-partner). They responded: "checking gateway logs, resending ACK now. ETA ~25m."

supply-partner: Apologies 1: EDI gateway had a transient drop. Re-sending ACK with allocation segment now, will confirm checksum to your SFTP.

jordan: While we wait ops: snapshot allocator state and create an override to avoid double-assign. I'll want an audit trail.

sam: Creating override ticket INF-4921 and locking reservation keys R-778..R-781.

ops-bot: ticket.created INF-4921 by sam (link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-4921)

ashwin: Partner ack landed at 02:28 UTC. Waiting on parse.

ops-bot: ingest.success EDI pipeline: ack.received::supply-partner::batch4 at 2024-12-18T02:29Z

jordan: See allocation segment. It maps to R-778..R-781 but totals 14 racks (2 short vs allocator expectation). Palletization fields differ which likely causes the two-rack drop.

ashwin: Reconcile choices: a) consume 2 racks from dedicated-spare-commit, b) backfill customer later with follow-on shipment, c) re-route 2 racks from EU staging (longer transit).

karen: SLA allows best-effort for initial ramp. Prefer (a) if spare pool available to keep launch on track.

sam: Spare pool shows 5 racks available but staging prep takes ~6 hours. If supply-partner can mark 2 missing racks as 'hold for Redwood' at crossdock, we can provision and avoid EU pull.

supply-partner: We can flag the two racks as hold and prioritize staging for Redwood. Carrier release expected +6h.

maria: I'll notify PM + marketing to hold announcements unless ops starts provisioning within 1 hour.

jordan: Once ops confirms INF-4921=in-progress I'll flip 2 racks from spare into the customer's reservation with manual override.

ops-bot: ticket.update INF-4921 status=in-progress assigned=sam

sam: Started provisioning. Estimated crossdock prep 5.5h. Locking the 2 racks in staging.

karen: Marketing: hold announcement until provisioning completes or we confirm full 16 racks.

ashwin: Postmortem TODO: tighten EDI monitoring -> compare SFTP manifests to reservation IDs earlier, and add auto-retry on missing allocation segments. I'll open a follow-up doc.

maria: Thanks. I'll coordinate messaging and flag legal if we need specific wording for the customer.

supply-partner: "Again sorry for the disruption. We'll implement automated re-ack and EDI retry for gateway drops and share remediation plan by EOD."
